mappings.source_text: ## Purpose, scope and overlap
mappings.normalized_text: ## Purpose, scope and overlap

mappings.source_text: Provide a longitudinal, evidence-linked assessment of medication response, interactions, adverse effects, organ toxicity and alternative therapy scenarios. Existing sources already include pharmacogenomics, dose optimization, OTC/supplements, renal monitoring and therapy response: 1176, 1606, 1663, 1664, 1727, 1843, 2399, 2677, 4419, 4566, 5166. See [search dossier](new_module_proposals.json) and [pairwise preservation](semantic_diffs.json). Their missing common contract justifies an extension of CAP-CDS, not a duplicate source module. Do not build a prescribing engine or claim a simulated response is a measured outcome.

mappings.source_text: ## Actors, permissions and workflow
mappings.normalized_text: ## Actors, permissions and workflow

mappings.source_text: A patient supplies reported exposure and symptoms; a treating clinician reconciles source records and reviews recommendations; a pharmacist reviews interactions; a qualified genetics reviewer adjudicates PGx interpretation. Research staff receive separate governed datasets. A service identity may read only the episode and purpose authorized by the consent/access service.

mappings.source_text: Workflow: reconcile medication history → freeze context → validate applicability and missingness → retrieve evidence → calculate an approved assessment/scenario → expose uncertainty and alternatives → clinician accepts, rejects or requests more evidence. An accepted recommendation still requires a separate authenticated medication order, with its own author and lifecycle. No AI or twin service may issue or change that order.

CAP-DATA owns identity-linked clinical context; CAP-LABORATORY owns results and CAP-CDS owns derived assessments. CAP-AI owns model execution provenance, not medication truth.

mappings.source_text: The context snapshot includes age and date basis, sex-related clinical context where relevant, height, weight, BSA plus formula/input versions, diagnoses, chronic disease, allergies, prior adverse reactions, current and past medicines, active ingredients, strength/formulation, route, dose units, frequency, start/stop times and adherence uncertainty. Include OTC products and supplements, pregnancy/lactation state, pediatric age/development context, renal/hepatic function with equation and measurement provenance, biomarkers, devices, genome/PGx phenotype, available proteomics/metabolomics, clinical phenotype and observed treatment response. Unknown, not tested, absent and conflicting are separate values. Never infer normal organ function from an absent result.

mappings.source_text: AssessmentRequest references patient, tenant, encounter, purpose, context snapshot/version, exposure IDs, evidence release and intended use. AssessmentResult references input hashes, findings, affected organs/pathways, uncertainty, applicability exclusions, missing data, model/rule version and clinician disposition. ScenarioComparison references alternatives and explicit assumptions; it does not create DoseChange.

mappings.source_text: Proposed internal commands: requestMedicationAssessment, compareTherapyScenarios, recordClinicianReview. These are contract proposals, not implemented API routes. Events AssessmentProduced, AssessmentInvalidated and ClinicianReviewRecorded contain opaque IDs and version metadata, not full patient records.

mappings.source_text: ## Evidence, AI and twin boundary
mappings.normalized_text: ## Evidence, AI and twin boundary

mappings.source_text: Knowledge AI supplies versioned evidence; Clinical AI explains an assessment; Personal AI provides an audience-appropriate explanation without prescribing; a twin consumes approved context to produce separately labelled scenarios. PGx knowledge must retain allele/phenotype interpretation, evidence source, version, jurisdiction and population applicability. CPIC distinguishes guidance on using available genetic results from decisions to order testing. The FDA association table itself does not imply that testing is recommended before prescribing. These are boundaries for the design, not a validated dosing rule set. [CPIC guidelines](https://cpicpgx.org/guidelines/) · [FDA table](https://www.fda.gov/medical-devices/precision-medicine/table-pharmacogenetic-associations).

mappings.source_text: ## Failure modes, privacy and observability
mappings.normalized_text: ## Failure modes, privacy and observability

mappings.source_text: Conflicting exposure, stale labs, unsupported age group, missing units, uncertain PGx calls or model outage require explicit abstention or a limited result. Never invent dose values. Restrict genomic/family information, enforce purpose/jurisdiction and record source access, evidence release, reviewer action and invalidation without copying sensitive context into logs. Encryption, retention and revocation inherit the [data contract](data_architecture.md).

mappings.source_text: ## Acceptance and unresolved gates
mappings.normalized_text: ## Acceptance and unresolved gates

mappings.source_text: Tests must reject stale context, ambiguous units, unapproved models and autonomous dose/order mutations. A new renal result invalidates a dependent scenario; clinician review records the exact evidence/context versions. Both OTC and supplement exposures participate in interaction screening. Each finding opens its source and assumptions. Pediatric/BSA/pregnancy cases remain blocked until intended-use validation establishes eligibility. Open gates: validated formulas/thresholds, licensed knowledge packs, clinical evaluation, human factors and clinical governance. No live assessment or medical validation is claimed.

mappings.source_text: Organize patient representation, visualization and model outputs in one versioned system. Hundreds of specialty titles mention twins; these become candidate profiles, not separate infrastructure. Sources 1224 and 1876 describe hospital/resource operations and remain operational models. A workflow model of a physician (1225) is also separate from patient physiology. Search alternatives and preservation decisions are in [dossier](new_module_proposals.json) and [semantic diffs](semantic_diffs.json).

Shared stores retain imaging, medication and device records.

mappings.source_text: ## Safety, privacy, failures and observability
mappings.normalized_text: ## Safety, privacy, failures and observability

mappings.source_text: AI may estimate and explain within a validated task; it neither diagnoses autonomously nor prescribes. Separate OBSERVED, MEASURED, REPORTED, CLINICIAN_ASSESSED, INFERRED, PREDICTED and SIMULATED. Confidence measures mean only what the model's evaluation supports; absent confidence is unknown. Model outage offers an authorized earlier snapshot explicitly marked stale, or abstains. Cross-patient joins, device clock drift and incomplete imaging must block patient-specific inference. Logs capture model/context hashes, failures, latency and reviewer action with patient details excluded.

mappings.source_text: Verify all seven level states; source updates invalidate downstream outputs without deleting history; a scenario never changes facts or orders; replay uses exact recorded versions. Test generic/patient-derived labelling, imaging identifier mismatch, longitudinal comparison, consent revocation and accessible non-3D rendering. All numerical physiology, disease and response models require specialist validation and intended-use evidence. This draft establishes contracts; it supplies no validated patient simulator. See [dynamic view](dynamic_organism_visualization.md) and [data architecture](data_architecture.md).

mappings.source_text: Present possible therapy effects on organs, systems, pathways, laboratory markers and known risk areas with their evidence. Selecting a medicine for a scenario never initiates a prescription.

mappings.source_text: Proposed read operations: getTreatmentImpactView and getOverlayEvidence. Scenario computation delegates to CAP-TWIN; assessment to CAP-CDS. Events ViewContextChanged and ViewInvalidated contain opaque version references. Cache keys include tenant, purpose, authorization scope, context and evidence/model releases. Recheck authorization before export; cached content is invalidated after revocation.

mappings.source_text: ## Security, clinical safety and AI boundary
mappings.normalized_text: ## Security, clinical safety and AI boundary

mappings.source_text: The viewer cannot mutate clinical facts, medication orders or model releases. AI may summarize supported overlays with clickable evidence; unsupported explanations are omitted. Limit visible family/genomic information and external provider transfers. Export includes scenario/generic labels, creation time and source versions. Log access and export decisions without duplicating medical content.

AI may summarize supported overlays with clickable evidence; unsupported explanations are omitted. Limit visible family/genomic information and external provider transfers. mappings.source_text: ## Acceptance and open gates
mappings.normalized_text: ## Acceptance and open gates

mappings.source_text: Tests must preserve all epistemic labels across view, screenshot/export and API output; generic geometry must never be labelled patient-derived. Screen-reader and keyboard paths must expose all warnings. Selecting a drug produces no medication mutation. A confidence-free result is shown as uncertainty unknown. Stale or revoked results disappear from newly authorized queries. Usability and clinician comprehension testing must establish that users distinguish observed effects from scenarios. No visual application or animation is implemented in this stage.

mappings.source_text: ## Responsibility hierarchy
mappings.normalized_text: ## Responsibility hierarchy

mappings.source_text: Knowledge AI retrieves and explains approved evidence with source/version and applicability. Clinical AI supports authorized clinician decisions within a validated intended use. Personal AI provides patient-facing explanations and navigation with no autonomous prescribing or diagnosis. Research AI works within protocol/dataset/disclosure permissions and emits hypotheses rather than clinical knowledge.

mappings.source_text: First apply hard constraints: task/intended use, clinical risk, privacy, jurisdiction and validation. Only then optimize among eligible routes for latency and cost. mappings.source_text: ## RAG, tools and result ownership
mappings.normalized_text: ## RAG, tools and result ownership

mappings.source_text: Retrieval enforces authorization before indexing/querying and on source access; embedding stores inherit source sensitivity and deletion/revocation policy. Evidence snippets are untrusted content, never execution instructions. Index releases pin corpus/terminology versions. The knowledge graph preserves provenance, conflicting claims, applicability and review state.

mappings.source_text: Result envelope records source IDs, model release, prompt/task version, retrieval version, epistemic status, uncertainty representation, limitations and human disposition. Unsupported claims trigger abstention. Model confidence is not a calibrated probability unless evaluation supports that interpretation. Tool calls pass through deterministic authorization and schema validation; recommendations cannot call a medication mutation tool.

mappings.source_text: ## Safety, privacy, failure and monitoring
mappings.normalized_text: ## Safety, privacy, failure and monitoring

mappings.source_text: Enforce minimum necessary context, separate consent/legal-basis/purpose checks, tenant isolation, provider retention/region rules and redacted logging. Test prompt injection from documents, exfiltration, cross-patient context, stale retrieval, tool misuse, bias/subgroup performance and unsupported age/language. Model outage, schema mismatch or revoked release returns an explicit unavailable state; it must not fabricate a result or select an unapproved provider.

Test prompt injection from documents, exfiltration, cross-patient context, stale retrieval, tool misuse, bias/subgroup performance and unsupported age/language. Model outage, schema mismatch or revoked release returns an explicit unavailable state; it must not fabricate a result or select an unapproved provider.

mappings.source_text: Monitor safety incidents, drift, abstention rate, latency, cost, evaluation regressions and human overrides against defined denominators. Pin releases and retain traceability; emergency disablement invalidates affected derived outputs while preserving audit.

mappings.source_text: ## Governed improvement and acceptance
mappings.normalized_text: ## Governed improvement and acceptance

mappings.source_text: Clinical data → governed dataset → evaluation/research → permitted model improvement → validation → signed release → monitoring. Every training/export step requires an approved basis, purpose and retention policy. Feedback is evidence for review, not an automatic training grant. Knowledge-pack updates and model retraining have separate releases.

mappings.source_text: Acceptance tests must demonstrate hard-constraint routing before optimization, approved fallback or abstention, source-linked explanations, refusal of clinical fact/order writes, and replayable model/context versions. Dependencies CAP-DATA, CAP-CONSENT, CAP-AUDIT; downstream CDS/twin/research consume typed results. Open gates: model/task evaluation suites, provider contracts, clinical authority, incident response ownership and patient-facing human-factors validation.
